description: Land Acquisition - Buddiyagama, Weeraketiya D/S Division, Hambanthota District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land lots being acquired by the government for public purposes, including lot numbers, land names, descriptions, claimants, and exact measurements. The content falls under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification.
